But why shoot them?''" <br/> "''Tinnies?''" <br/> "''What did your squad call them?''" <br/> "''Droids.''|[[Clone commando/Legends|Clone commando]]s [[Atin Skirata|Atin]] and [[Fi Skirata|Fi]]|<ref name="RC1">''[[Republic Commando: Hard Contact]]''</ref>}}
'''Tinnie''' was a slang term used to refer to [[Droid/Legends|droids]].<ref name="RC1" /> Like "[[Clanker/Legends|clanker]]", it was often used by [[Clone trooper/Legends|clone trooper]]s and [[Clone commando/Legends|clone commando]]s.<ref name="RC1" />
